propositions: Add CLI flag `--retry` to resume only the literal latest eligible indeterminate review with fresh per-invocation attempt budget, reusing checkpointed findings from successful/resumed units and re-running failed/cancelled units and budget-shed findings

Eligibility gate requires latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar with versioned discovery_journal; refuse before any model call if result is non-indeterminate, journal is missing/stale/legacy/corrupt, or recomputed identity digest no longer matches stored checkpoint digests

Reconstruct checkpoint_identity/identity_digest from current ticket material, code/ref, effective policy, prompts/contracts, model/mode, topology, context, dependencies, and source; load envelope via sizing.load_checkpoint and reuse stored findings for matching units; treat mismatched or absent envelopes as missing

Pass-2 verification and coaching reuse unchanged per-finding successes and run only for newly recovered work; deterministic decision, assembly, signature, and response rendering rerun over combined result

`--retry` is mutually exclusive with `--force`, `--status`, and `--check`; compatible with `--no-sign`; refusal exits with established indeterminate code (exit 2) and prints full-review remedy to stderr

Document flag in canonical help, CLI reference, user guide, plan-review gate guide, and exit-codes guide covering eligibility, fresh budget, reuse/refusal behavior, flag interactions, signing, and normal-full-review fallback
